name: Candace Machado
occupation: Former Evansville mayor (Oil City News, Nov. 4, 2026)
prior_offices: Mayor of Evansville (Oil City News, Nov. 4, 2026)
background: Candace Machado of Natrona County ran as a Democrat in the November 2026 general election for Natrona County commissioner and lost. Oil City News identified her as a former Evansville mayor and reported that she received 5,734 votes, finishing behind the three Republicans elected to the board.

sources.name: Oil City News, Nov. 4, 2026, Republicans sweep Wyoming's federal, state and Natrona County elections
